baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from endurance through seeking, maintained prayer, two visibility modes of giving, and ongoing moral counteraction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Endurance holds the self steady under one governing direction; prayer maintains that direction, and giving remains continuous whether concealed or observed. The list therefore behaves as one visibility-invariant regimen rather than unrelated virtues.

activation_trace.role: Self-restraint supplies the held inner posture and makes endurance active rather than mere delay.
Directed seeking supplies an explicit object of desire and gives the endurance its aim.
Direction and destination supply the governing orientation toward which the practices are aligned.
Care, preservation, and oversight supply sustained maintenance, so prayer is kept operative.
Concealment in the interior supplies the unobserved mode in which the same giving continues.
Manifest visibility supplies the observed mode and tests continuity of purpose across exposure.

changed_reading.before: A catalog of patience, prayer, charity, and good conduct.
changed_reading.after: A single directed discipline whose orientation and generosity remain stable when no one sees and when everyone can see.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive source of provision, spending from only part of what was supplied, and goodness acting against injury.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord nurtures and apportions; provision then exits the recipients instead of terminating in them. Beneficent action is the medium used against what harms, so the agents function as stewards who keep received good moving onward.

activation_trace.role: Nurture, repair, and completion supply the upstream relation from which the regimen is sustained.
The departure of wealth in expenditure supplies outward transfer rather than retained possession.
A passage with an outlet supplies a circulation image for provision moving through its recipient.
An apportioned gift supplies the incoming resource and limits any claim of self-originating ownership.
Beneficent action toward another supplies the active counter-medium rather than a merely attractive quality.
What grieves or injures supplies the adverse force that the good action meets.
The final consequence supplied by the branch makes the dwelling the result of the circuit's operation.

changed_reading.before: People give some privately owned wealth and are later rewarded.
changed_reading.after: Recipients of an allotment become conduits: they release provision and convert encounters with injury into further beneficent action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing construction joins an aftermath to a dwelling after a sequence of repeated practices.
baseline_models.mechanism: What follows an act can be a succession, remainder, or recurring return, while a dwelling can enclose, circulate around, and identify its resident. The ethical sequence can therefore be read as accumulating an after-condition that eventually becomes habitable.

activation_trace.role: Successive coming-after supplies a temporal chain linking repeated practices to what follows them.
A remainder or persistent trace supplies the accumulated material of the eventual condition.
Circulation and enclosure supply the spatial conversion of repeated consequences into an environment.
Residence and belonging to a dwelling supply the endpoint as inhabitation, not a detached prize.

changed_reading.before: A good final residence is appended as compensation for the listed deeds.
changed_reading.after: The deeds leave successive traces that gather into the very after-condition their agents will inhabit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier demand accelerates bad ahead of good; the focus reverses both sequence and agency by placing good in the instrumental position against bad. Good action becomes an interruption of a destructive temporal order.

activation_trace.role: Hastening and putting forward supply the accelerated timing that the focus later interrupts.
Precedence and approach supply the explicit bad-before-good ordering that is reversed in the focus.
The distressing or injurious item supplies the pole demanded first in the earlier sequence.
Beneficent action supplies the delayed pole that the focus instead advances as its instrument.

structural_cues: 13:6 orders bad before good, whereas 13:22 grammatically makes good the instrument acting on bad.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit earlier order and the focus supplies the inverted instrumental construction; I infer a deliberate ethical counter-order. A live alternative is that the two clauses only share conventional opposites.

changed_reading.before: Responding to a bad act with a good one.
changed_reading.after: Interrupting the rush toward harm by putting beneficent action first and making it govern what happens next.

context_deltas.mechanism: Knowledge spans what is absent from sight and what is witnessed, then the next ayah equalizes concealed and declared speech. Secret and public giving consequently become two observer states under one audit, strengthening the baseline's claim of stable orientation.

activation_trace.role: Being screened from eyes supplies the unobserved state covered by divine knowledge.
Presence with witnessing supplies the observed state paired with the unseen.
Interior concealment supplies a contextual instance of action hidden from other people.
Public declaration supplies the exposed counterpart and completes the visibility test.

structural_cues: The unseen/witnessed pair in 13:9 is immediately enacted as concealed/declared speech in 13:10 and recurs as secret/public giving in 13:22.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three aligned visibility binaries; I infer that the focus tests invariance of purpose across them. The alternative is a simple enumeration of permissible giving modes without an integrity test.

changed_reading.before: Giving may appropriately be private or public.
changed_reading.after: Giving is run through both hidden and exposed conditions to show that its direction does not depend on an audience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The futile image stretches open palms toward water in an attempt to acquire, yet nothing reaches the mouth. The focus reverses the vector: provision is released from the holder, making generosity an effective outward reach rather than an empty acquisitive gesture.

activation_trace.role: Extending and opening the hand supplies the bodily gesture whose direction is reversed by spending.
The literal palm supplies the receiving surface that remains ineffective when it only reaches to acquire.
Arrival at a destination supplies the failed efficacy test: the water never reaches its intended end.
Wealth leaving in expenditure supplies the opposite vector, an outward transfer that can actually reach beyond the self.

structural_cues: The 13:14 simile extends palms toward water but twice denies arrival to the mouth; 13:22 sends received provision away from its holder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed inward acquisition and successful outward expenditure; I infer a reversal of the hand's vector. The live alternative is that the simile concerns false invocation only and has no bearing on giving.

changed_reading.before: Spending is the charitable use of one's hand and wealth.
changed_reading.after: The hand becomes effective when it stops grasping toward itself and releases provision toward a destination beyond itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water is routed through channels by capacity and fire processes material; in both, raised foam is cast away while benefit remains. The repeated seeking term contrasts ornament or utility with the focus's higher direction, and good acting on bad becomes a selective process that removes waste while preserving what can remain.

activation_trace.role: A valley as the path of a flood supplies the channel through which mixed material is processed.
A bounded measure supplies differentiated carrying capacity rather than undirected abundance.
Floating foam supplies the prominent but non-enduring layer separated from the useful flow.
Purposeful seeking supplies the shared motive-form while its object shifts to ornament or utility.
Castoff refuse supplies the removal endpoint for what only floated on the process.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the criterion for what deserves preservation.
Remaining steadily with time supplies the durable residue that the moral process seeks.

structural_cues: 13:17 repeats the focus's seeking form with ornament/utility as its object, then contrasts floating discard with benefit that remains after water and fire processes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies channels, capacity, foam, discard, and durable benefit; I map that process onto good displacing bad in the focus. The alternative is that the process illustrates truth and falsehood only, with no transfer to the focus's ethics.

changed_reading.before: Good behavior replaces or compensates for bad behavior.
changed_reading.after: Good is a processing medium: it routes a mixed event through capacity, ejects the harmful froth, and preserves durable benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is enclosed by fulfillment and connection on one side and severance and corruption on the other. Patience, spending across visibility, and answering harm with good become practical maintenance operations on a covenantal network, not only private merits.

activation_trace.role: Completion without deficiency supplies the standard by which covenant performance is maintained.
Repeated preservation and care supply the temporal work required by an enduring commitment.
A confirmed compact supplies the binding structure that the focus's practices keep intact.
Maintaining relation and refusing estrangement supply the positive network operation adjacent to the focus.
Severing connection and estrangement supply the exact failure mode opposed to that maintenance.
Departure from soundness supplies the system-level result when bonds are cut rather than repaired.

structural_cues: 13:20-21 move from keeping a compact to joining what must be joined; 13:22 gives the practices; 13:25 mirrors the sequence with breaking, cutting, and corrupting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a flanking connect-versus-cut architecture; I infer that the focus names mechanisms that preserve the connections. The alternative is that each ayah lists independent traits and consequences without a network function.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes an individual's patient piety and generosity.
changed_reading.after: The focus describes how a person keeps a social covenant from tearing: sustain, transfer resources, and repair injury with good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The outcome is entered with sound kin, repeatedly entered by messengers from every gate, and greeted as safety explicitly because of patience. This turns the focus's closing dwelling into relationally inhabited peace and directly confirms patience as causal preparation for it.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an interior supplies the enacted transition from promised outcome to inhabited place.
Soundness opposed to corruption supplies the quality by which family relations join the destination.
An entrance supplies permeability and repeated arrival rather than a sealed private reward.
Safety and freedom from harm supply the lived condition produced inside the outcome.
Held self-restraint supplies the explicitly named reason for the greeting and outcome.
Final consequence supplies the repeated closure that confirms the focus's endpoint.
Residence and belonging supply the outcome as a place occupied in peace.

structural_cues: 13:23 places family and repeated entry immediately after the focus; 13:24 directly repeats patience, aftermath, and dwelling with a causal because-of relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly ties patience to greeting and outcome; I infer that the dwelling is defined by relationally inhabited safety. The alternative is that family entry and greeting are reward details without redefining the focus's closing phrase.

changed_reading.before: The patient receive a good residence at the end.
changed_reading.after: Their practiced non-retaliation prepares an inhabitable peace into which repaired relations and welcoming presences can enter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision is explicitly expanded for some and narrowed for others, while worldly use is temporary. Spending from what was provided is therefore proportional onward circulation under unequal allocations, not generosity measured by an absolute stock.

activation_trace.role: Expansion, abundance, and surplus supply one end of the variable allocation range.
An apportioned gift supplies the repeated reminder that the resource arrives before it is spent.
Narrowing to a small measure supplies the other end of the allocation range.
Temporary usable benefit supplies the resource's limited tenure and weakens possessive attachment.
Outward expenditure supplies the required response to whatever measure has been received.

structural_cues: 13:26 places expansion and restriction around the same provision root used in the focus and then relativizes worldly utility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unequal divine allocation and limited utility; I infer that the focus evaluates faithful release relative to receipt, not sheer amount. The alternative is that 13:26 only explains economic variation and consolation.

changed_reading.before: The virtuous give a portion of their wealth.
changed_reading.after: They pass onward from a variable allotment whose source, scale, and duration deny absolute ownership.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast expands aftermath into flowing water, lasting nourishment, sheltering shade, or consuming fire. The focus's dwelling is thus an ecology sustained by flows and cover, sharpening the baseline's inhabited-aftercondition model.

activation_trace.role: Continuous flowing and spreading supply the sustaining movement inside the good outcome.
Stillness with duration supplies persistence to nourishment rather than a momentary award.
Protective shade supplies environmental cover and relief within the dwelling.
Final consequence names both contrasted outcomes and binds the ecology directly to aftermath.
Kindled fire supplies the consuming counter-environment against which flow, food, and shade are defined.

structural_cues: 13:35 explicitly predicates two contrasted aftermaths, elaborating one with river, lasting produce, and shade and the other with fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit aftermath contrast and its environmental contents; I infer that these contents unpack the focus's dwelling as a lived ecology. The alternative is to treat them as separate reward images with no feedback into 13:22.

changed_reading.before: The closing phrase promises a favorable house or destination.
changed_reading.after: It promises an enduring ecology of beneficial circulation, nourishment, and cover, contrasted with an ecology that consumes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later divine pair of erasing and fixing activates a two-operation reading of the focus: prayer maintains a stable positive pattern while good action removes the effective trace of bad. The analogy concerns operation, not equality between divine and human agency.

activation_trace.role: Removal of a trace supplies the subtractive operation that clarifies what moral counteraction can accomplish.
Strengthening and fixing in place supply the constructive operation paired with removal.
Maintenance and guardianship supply the human practice that keeps the positive pattern standing.
Beneficent action supplies the positive material used in the focus's subtractive response.
Moral badness supplies the trace or pattern targeted by that response.

structural_cues: The paired verbs erase/fix in 13:39 echo the focus's paired operations of maintaining prayer and repelling bad with good, but the grammatical subjects differ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a divine erase-and-fix pair and a human maintain-and-repel pair; I infer operational analogy while preserving different agents and scales. The alternative is that decree in 13:39 is wholly unrelated to ethical repair in 13:22.

changed_reading.before: Prayer adds merit and good behavior opposes wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: The practices form a two-part edit: establish a durable positive pattern and erase the continuing trace of harm through beneficent action.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines branch-distant material senses of stopper, conduit, hollow, residue, and circulation. It remains anchored to the focus's exact endurance, expenditure, hidden/public, aftermath, and dwelling sequence; downstream prose should present it only as a systems analogy, never as the lexical translation of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moves from held endurance to provision leaving through hidden and public modes, then counterforce, residue, and dwelling.

activation_trace.role: A stopper sealing an opening supplies controlled containment and lets endurance be pictured as holding pressure.
A tunnel with an outlet supplies routed release and pictures spending as flow through a conduit.
A hollow shaft or channel supplies concealed interior transit before anything becomes visible.
Emergence into manifest visibility supplies the exposed outlet of the same routed action.
A remainder left after a process supplies the durable residue produced by repeated moral routing.
Circulation and enclosure supply the system boundary in which that residue becomes an environment.

changed_reading.before: A sequence of inward patience followed by outward acts.
changed_reading.after: A pressure-managed circuit: contain reactive force, route provision through concealed and exposed outlets, use good as counterforce, and inhabit what remains.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the two-faced branch is not the default sense of the focus's face term. It remains anchored by the singular sought face and the immediate secret/public pair; downstream prose should use it as an integrity test across audiences, not accuse the subjects of duplicity or redefine the divine face.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: One sought face governs conduct performed in two opposed visibility modes.

activation_trace.role: The image of two inconsistent faces supplies the latent failure mode against which one orientation is tested.
A single direction and destination supply the coherent alternative to audience-dependent faces.
Interior concealment supplies the private condition in which one possible social face cannot be inspected.
Public manifestation supplies the condition in which another social face could be performed.

changed_reading.before: Sincerity means seeking the Lord while giving both privately and publicly.
changed_reading.after: The one sought Face audits whether the giver remains one person across two visibility regimes instead of producing a private face and a public face.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the offspring branch inside a word normally read here as final outcome. It remains anchored by that focus word and the immediate entry of sound parents and spouses in 13:23; downstream prose should retain it as a secondary lineage and household resonance, not displace the eschatological outcome.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The aftermath term carries a latent descendant sense just before the context opens the dwelling to family relations.

activation_trace.role: Children and descendants supply a lineage sense of what remains after a person.
Residence and belonging supply the household frame within which lineage consequence can be inhabited.
Soundness opposed to corruption supplies the condition carried into the family grouping.
Parenthood and nurture supply the upward generational relation named immediately after the focus.
The marriage pair supplies the lateral household relation joined to the outcome.

changed_reading.before: The individual actor receives a later dwelling.
changed_reading.after: The actor's aftermath also resonates as a household and lineage consequence, with repaired relations among what remains after the self.

strongest_changes: The virtue list became a visibility-invariant stewardship and repair circuit.
Good acting against bad became both a temporal reversal and a separation process that ejects waste while preserving benefit.
The final dwelling became a relational and ecological after-condition generated by successive traces, not merely an appended prize.
summary.what_was_special: Repeated roots and flanking oppositions made 13:22 a hinge between bad-before-good and good-against-bad, connection and cutting, hidden and witnessed action, passing foam and durable benefit. Branch-distant pressure-routing, two-face, and lineage activations remained live under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: Several causal links are reader-supplied from sequence and reversal; the context can also be read as juxtaposed examples.
The material conduit and two-face readings are analogical activations, not default lexical senses.
The relational and ecological dwelling models should coexist with, not erase, the ordinary final-outcome reading.
